effect.name: Gradient Map
effect.description: Throws away the hue and re-colours the sprite by brightness across four stops. This is how you get a whole scene onto one palette in a single pass: the defaults are already the DMG greens, darkest to lightest.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Stop 1 (darkest)
parameter.description: Colour for the darkest pixels. Default is DMG 15,56,15.

parameter.name: Stop 2
parameter.description: Colour for the dark midtones. Default is DMG 48,98,48.

parameter.name: Stop 3
parameter.description: Colour for the light midtones. Default is DMG 139,172,15.

parameter.name: Stop 4 (lightest)
parameter.description: Colour for the brightest pixels. Default is DMG 155,188,15.

parameter.name: Offset
parameter.description: Slides every pixel up or down the ramp. Negative darkens the whole image.

parameter.name: Contrast
parameter.description: Widens or narrows the brightness range before it hits the ramp.

parameter.name: Amount
parameter.description: Blends the mapped colour back over the original.
